blocking_findings.summary: [P1] Do not derive per-triple bucket amounts from GL-level results (backend/src/mis/mis-selection.service.ts:150): The result has already been re-aggregated to GL/month, but this map keys amounts only by `gl_code` and then assigns that total to every configured bucket triple for that GL.

t-ui-c3: the unmapped-GL bucket is rendered as a reviewable list of its triples with amounts so the mapping gap is visible rather than absorbed, and the MIS Reports navigation item and page title are enabled in the application shell

non_blocking_findings.summary: [P2] Remove the generated Next.js trace from the change (.next/trace:1): `.next/trace` is volatile development-build output containing run-specific timestamps and a trace identifier.
